values: 一名拥有超凡感知能力的魔法射手，能与魔法猎鹰共同作战。
A magical Marksman who is gifted with extraordinary perception and has a falcon to fight with.
有什么事？也许我的伙伴能帮上忙。
What's the matter? Perhaps my companion may assist.
（思考）嗯……（艾洛娜飞来，侧头，伸手接住）来得正好，艾洛娜（艾洛娜点头，侧头倾听，艾洛娜梳理羽毛）嗯……嗯，原来如此。（摸摸艾洛娜）知道了，谢谢你。
Well, just in time. Mm... mm, I see. Understood, thank you.
（艾洛娜蹦跶飞起来）……嗯？怎么？（侧头看向艾洛娜，摸胸毛）做得很好。
（手聚集魔法）风带来了新的消息……（挥手发出）去吧
您很善于察觉别人的喜好，这是您的天赋之一。
You are adept at sensing the preferences of others; it's a talent of yours.
在碧海的呼唤中。捕捉最细微的声音。
Among the whispering leaves, he catches every breath of the ever-green sea.
碧沙涌动，星辉散落如织。
Waves crash, sands shift, as starlight dances on the breeze.
Let's rest for ten minutes here.
艾洛娜很喜欢新的灯光
Elona really loves the new lights.
Snow will probably fall tonight too.
布莱恩听觉灵敏，不喜欢嘈杂的环境，尤其不能忍受洛桑的喋喋不休。
Due to Bryon's acute hearing, he strongly dislikes noisy environments and finds Lorsan's incessant chatter especially unbearable.
“呵，呵，布莱恩不喜欢对别人说起自己的事，如果你们刨根问底的话，他可能会装作没听到。”雅顿常对来找布莱恩的人这么说。
"Bryon isn't fond of sharing his personal affairs with others. Even if you discern the truth, he may just pretend not to hear you."—Arden's advice to anyone who comes looking for Bryon.
布莱恩十分低调，在学生时代并不出色，大多数人不知道他被贤者雅顿选中的理由。
Bryon tends to keep a very low profile. His grades were not particularly good during his school days, leading many questioning why Arden chose him as a pupil.
和老师雅顿一样，布莱恩深居简出，比他的老师更加惜字如金。甚至有些人觉得他不会说话。
Much like Arden, Bryon is extremely reclusive and even more selective of his words than his own teacher. Some are even convinced that he cannot speak at all.
艾洛娜并非布莱恩饲养的宠物。在布莱恩看来，是艾洛娜选择成为他的同伴，他对此深怀感激。
Elona is not Bryon's pet. She's his companion. Bryon has been very grateful ever since Elona chose to stay by his side.
布莱恩并非盲人，这一点除了他的老师鲜有人知晓。如果去问洛桑，他则会假装大吃一惊，然后露出得意的笑容。

Bryon is not actually blind, a fact known to very few people aside from his teacher. If you ask Lorsan about this, he will feign utter shock while smiling in secret. "Really? I've known him all these years, and I never knew."
“那家伙小时候可吓人了，随便就能说中人家心里的事，简直就像有读心术一样。”布莱恩小时候的玩伴至今仍心有余悸。
"That guy was terrifying as a kid. He knew exactly what other people were thinking, as though he could read their minds."—A childhood friend of Bryon who still has a lingering fear of him.
“我记得小时候没什么人敢跟他说话，只有丛林中的鸟兽陪伴他，后来，洛桑和莱卡开始和他搭话。”达赫妮婆婆这样回忆道。

"I remember no one wanting to talk to him when he was little; only the forest creatures were willing to keep him company. But then one day, Lyca and Lorsan started talking to him."—Granny Dahnie, when recalling Bryon's childhood.
布莱恩的敏锐也许会让人疏远他，却让艾洛娜成了他忠实的同伴，他们一起出现的身影已经长达七年。
Bryon's sharp personality sometimes keeps others at a distance, but it makes a trustworthy companion out of Elona. The two have been inseparable for the last seven years or so.
很少有人知道，布莱恩能用口哨吹出非常美丽动听的曲调。
Not many people know this, but Bryon is capable of whistling beautiful and intricate melodies. Because of this, he has gained a few admirers, even one as far as Ivoryshade.
Let's rest for ten minutes here.
艾洛娜很喜欢新的灯光
Elona really loves the new lights.
Snow will probably fall tonight too.
啊，真是麻烦……我讨厌工作。
布莱恩先生，我一直很好奇，你为什么总是戴着眼罩呢？
Mr. Bryon, just out of curiosity, may I ask why you always wear a blindfold?
漫漫 & 布莱恩 & 洛桑
布莱恩先生，天空中正在飞翔的那个影子……是艾洛娜吗？
Bryon, that person soaring in the sky... Is that Elona?
布莱恩的艾洛娜很漂亮哇，她的眼睛像宝石一样单良，羽毛也很润顺！
Bryon's companion, Elona, is so beautiful. Her eyes are as clear as diamonds. Her feathers are as smooth as silk.
漫漫 & 满满 & 布莱恩
与我共饮吧，在这美丽的村落；与我共饮吧，为这宁静的时光……
♪ ...In this beautiful village, drink with me. In this quiet time, drink with me... ♪
布莱恩，不要递给我那份芜菁豆子汤……
Don't hand me that turnip soup, Bryon...
